title.narrative: UNICEF expanded the community nutrition surveillance from 313 sentinel sites to 451 across 34 provinces, surveying 36,000 children during January to June 2025. Furthermore, UNICEF studied the effectiveness of the simplified wasting treatment protocol, the determinants of stunting and child food poverty using MICS 2023, to inform nutrition strategy in 2025 and beyond.
